query.statement: INSERT INTO TB_REPORTEXECUTION (REPORTEXECUTION_ID, NAME, STATUS_CD, CREATED_BY, CREATED_AT, UPDATED_BY, UPDATED_AT) VALUES (?, ?, ?, ?, SYSDATE, ?, SYSDATE)
SELECT REPORTEXECUTION_ID, NAME, STATUS_CD, UPDATED_AT FROM TB_REPORTEXECUTION WHERE NAME LIKE '%' || ? || '%' AND STATUS_CD = ? ORDER BY UPDATED_AT DESC
SELECT REPORTEXECUTION_ID, NAME, STATUS_CD, CREATED_BY, CREATED_AT, UPDATED_BY, UPDATED_AT FROM TB_REPORTEXECUTION WHERE REPORTEXECUTION_ID = ?
UPDATE TB_REPORTEXECUTION SET NAME = ?, STATUS_CD = ?, UPDATED_BY = ?, UPDATED_AT = SYSDATE WHERE REPORTEXECUTION_ID = ?
